measures.title: Saginaw County 9-1-1 Authority Millage Renewal Proposal
measures.summary: Would renew Saginaw County's property tax of up to 0.28 mill ($0.28 per $1,000 of taxable value) for 2028 through 2037. The money pays for replacing outdated fire, police and emergency medical radio equipment and other 9-1-1 Central Dispatch equipment, and for continuing operations of the Saginaw County 9-1-1 Authority. The first-year levy is estimated to raise $2,031,015.
measures.yesMeans: Saginaw County would continue levying up to 0.28 mill for 9-1-1 dispatch for 2028 through 2037.
measures.noMeans: The 9-1-1 Authority millage would not be renewed.

measures.title: Proposed City Charter Amendment to Section 45
measures.summary: Section 45 of the Saginaw city charter limits the city property tax rate to the lesser of 7.5 mills or the rate needed to raise the same revenue the city received in fiscal year 1978-1979 ($3,828,778), and allows a temporary 3 mill additional tax for a declared emergency. The amendment would remove the cap on the total dollar amount of revenue that may be levied, while keeping the other provisions, including the number of mills that may be levied.
measures.yesMeans: The charter's cap on the total dollar amount of property tax revenue would be removed; the millage limits would stay.
measures.noMeans: The charter's limit tied to 1978-1979 revenue would remain in place.
